FT600: Forté Café Table with Molded Top
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/norix-ft600-forte-36-inch-round-top-cafe-table-n700159
Manufacturer page: https://norix.com/product/forte-cafe/
Spec sheets: FT600 Forté Café Table, Molded Top, Forté Brochure
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Norix Forté Molded Café Table with 36” Round Top – FT600
Current H1: Norix Forté Durable Round-Top Café Table - FT600
Subtitle: Rotationally Molded Round Café Table on an Hourglass Base That Pairs with Forté Guest Chairs
Current subtitle: Norix Furniture Forté Series FT600 Cafeteria Table with 36" Round Top
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Norix Forté Café Table with Molded Top is a 36” round, rotationally molded polyethylene table on a cylindrical hourglass base that pairs with Forté Guest Chairs. It is made for daily use in dining areas, dayrooms, and visitation rooms in behavioral healthcare and correctional facilities.
The lightly textured, maintenance-free surface can be cleaned with bleach solutions and hospital-grade disinfectants. The table ships knocked down to save on shipping. To validate the warranty, it must be bolted down or ballasted with about 150 lbs of dry sand or gravel; it holds up to 200 lbs of ballast, or it can be factory ballasted with 150 lbs.
Construction: One-piece, rotationally molded high-impact polyethylene with UV stabilizers and a lightly textured, maintenance-free surface
TruColor Polymer: Fully compounded color for consistent color and durability
Chemical Resistance: Resists blood, vinegar, urine, feces, salt solution, and chlorine solution
Overall Size: 36” diameter × 29.2”H
Weight: 31 lbs
Colors: Sienna, Dove, or Raven
Static Load Testing: Tested to 1,000 lbs
Flammability Standards: California Technical Bulletins 133 and 117; UL 1056; ASTM E1537; NFPA 261; UL 94 HB
Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD and GREENGUARD Gold
Cleaning: Simple Green or a similar cleaner for routine cleaning; bleach and water solutions and hospital-grade disinfectants such as Virex, Wexcide, or Oxivir Five 16 can be used per the manufacturer’s instructions
Warranty: 10-year limited replacement warranty; to validate it, the table must be bolted down or ballasted with 150 lbs of sand
Intended Use: Indoor use only
Country of Manufacture: USA
Available Models and Options
FT600 – 36” Round Molded Top: 36” diameter, 31 lbs
Options: Factory ballasting (150 lbs)
Installation and Options
Assembly: Ships knocked down; assemble following Norix instructions
Ballast: Required to validate the warranty; Norix recommends 150 lbs of dry sand or gravel (up to 200 lbs, not supplied by Norix)
[H2] Applications
The Norix Forté Café Table with Molded Top suits rooms where residents eat, play games, or meet visitors, and where a table has to be easy to clean and hard to move.
Typical applications include:
Dining areas, dayrooms, and activity rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Cafeterias, dayrooms, and visitation rooms in correctional and detention facilities
Transitional housing and shelters
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture, Prison and Detention Furniture, and Transitional Housing Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Norix Forté Furniture
Norix Forté is a designer series of seating and tables that brings comfort and a less institutional look to intensive-use rooms in behavioral healthcare and correctional facilities. The chairs and molded bases are rotationally molded from high-impact polyethylene with Norix TruColor polymer, and many pieces can be ballasted, bolted down, or ganged together.
The Forté series includes:
Guest Chairs: Guest arm and armless chairs, with or without upholstery
Lounge Chairs: Lounge arm and armless chairs on a molded plinth base or a solid hardwood base, with or without upholstery
Café Tables: A 36” round molded table, 42” and 48” round and 42” square laminate tops, and a 42” square DuoForm top, all on a molded hourglass base
Occasional Tables: 27” square laminate-top tables on a molded or wood base, which can be ganged with lounge chairs as intermediate or corner tables
[H2] About Norix Furniture
Norix manufactures durable furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, police stations, correctional institutions, and residential treatment centers. Explore the full line of Norix Furniture at Anchortex.

Notes and Questions
Series section: same "About Norix Forté Furniture" section as the FC600 tab.
PRICE: the live page shows $131.20 with a compare-at of $164. $164 is the price of the factory ballasting option; the FT600 table itself is $871 on the Norix April 2026 price list. At your usual 80% of list, the price would be $696.80 (compare-at $871).
PHOTOS: the 3 table photos on our page show wood-grain laminate tops, which look like the CA4200 laminate café table, not the FT600 one-piece molded table. I could not find an FT600 photo on the Norix website. Would you like me to ask Norix, or should the current photos stay?
Ballast: the current page says "Recommend 200 pounds"; the spec sheet recommends 150 lbs and allows up to 200 lbs. I used the spec sheet.
Bolt-down: the spec sheet says the warranty requires a bolt-down kit or ballast, but the price list shows only factory ballasting as an FT600 option. I kept the spec sheet wording.
Colors: the price list gives only Sienna, Dove, and Raven for the FT600 (one-piece molded), so I listed those as the table colors.
Weight and size match the spec sheet and the worksheet (row 201: 31 / 36 / 36 / 29.2).
Collections: the table is already in Behavioral Healthcare, Prison and Detention Furniture, Transitional Housing, and Norix Furniture. I added a Transitional Housing Furniture link, since all seven Forté products are in that collection.
Removed: the long old series paragraph and the long old "About Norix Furniture" paragraph; replaced with the new Forté section and the standard paragraph used on all Norix pages.
